purpose: Provide an inline save/discard boundary for host-owned dirty data.
behaviorProvider: React promise lifecycle composed with shared Button controls.

requirements.statement: Render while dirty or saving; changing dirty to false during a save keeps the pending boundary visible until settlement.
Ignore save attempts while already pending or disabled. Await onSave and show shared loading state without starting overlapping saves.
Catch rejected saves and render an alert while retaining host dirty state; a later attempt clears the previous error before invoking onSave.
Disable discard while saving or disabled; otherwise clear the local error and invoke onDiscard synchronously without adding a confirmation dialog.
Expose a named Unsaved changes region, aria-busy while saving, and a status message that changes to Saving your changes during the request.
Maintain the actual draft, compare it with persisted data, and clear dirty only after the host accepts a save or discard. The bar never infers persistence from new props.
Validate inputs and enforce authorization or record version checks in onSave. Reject the promise to show a save error; no native form submission is inferred.
Provide any discard confirmation and route guard separately. Unmount suppresses later local state updates but does not cancel the host save or roll back a side effect.
Own pattern or component styling consumes workflow group tokens. Nested shared components retain their own group ownership; do not restyle their internals.

limitations: No draft storage, automatic dirty reset, confirmation, route interception or beforeunload handler.
No AbortSignal or version/conflict handling is supplied by this bar.
A successful promise is not independently verified as durable persistence.
